# Third-Party Browser Libraries

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

These files are distributed with the Web/PWA. The build preserves the licenses in this directory. The third-party libraries' application logic has not been modified.

| File | Upstream project | License |
|---|---|---|
| `supabase.umd.js` | [supabase-js 2.112.3](https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js/tree/v2.112.3) | [MIT](licenses/supabase-js.txt) |
| `qrcode.min.js` | [QRCode.js](https://github.com/davidshimjs/qrcodejs) | [MIT](licenses/qrcodejs.txt) |
| `jsqr.js` | [jsQR](https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR) | [Apache-2.0](licenses/jsqr.txt) |

The imported QR libraries have no recorded version. Before updating, record the upstream version and verify QR generation, scanning, and offline use. Third-party licenses apply to their respective dependencies; Six Things' own code uses the MIT license in the root LICENSE file.
